description: This file defines a Java interface CustomerDAO that declares data access methods related to Customer objects within the salesmanager project. It extends a generic DAO interface and includes methods for retrieving customers by name, store, nick, and criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers with the specified name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers for a specific store based on given criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname and store ID.
